# Moss Wood surface detail

Author: Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven
Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/moss_wood
License: CC0 1.0, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Provider license: https://polyhaven.com/license
Downloaded 2026-10-17: 1K JPG Diffuse and OpenGL normal maps.

Used as surface detail on the prototype's project-authored algae coating.
This is a moss-on-wood scan, used as an artistic placeholder for attached marine growth;
it is not a biological reconstruction or a scanned marine algae asset.
Small algae fronds and their meshes are authored in ReefCleaningBuilder.

Other candidates reviewed (not imported):
- https://opengameart.org/content/10-seaweed-variations-high-poly — p0ss, GPL 2.0, about 20k polygons/model; tall seaweed rather than attached turf.
- https://polyhaven.com/a/moss_01 — Rob Tuytel, CC0, moss rather than marine algae, 246k triangles at full detail.
